description_en: Retrieves the download URL for pipeline build artifacts
description_zh: 获取流水线构建产物下载地址
name: GetPipelineArtifactUrl

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can obtain this string from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The file path. You can obtain it through the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en: The file name. You can obtain it through the API at https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称，可通过API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/460565.html 获取
parameters.name: file_name

fileUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the file. The URL is valid for one hour
fileUrl.description_zh: 文件临时下载路径，一个小时有效期

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique ID to facilitate troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题
requestId.title_en: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values: true: The API call is successful. false: The API call failed
